title: Without See Financial Data the Shop supplies field is not shown
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, flagged as an Internal customer.
  • Have a new internal work order for this test, work order 1, for internal customer A, in status Approved, whose Shop supplies amount is $15.00.
  • Sign in as a user whose role has 'Work Orders — Create & Edit' but not 'See Financial Data', at the test location.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • No "Shop supplies" field shows on work order 1.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11767 (Story 10, Shop supplies on internal and no-charge work orders)

  • S10-N3: “If the user does not have 'See Financial Data', the field is not shown, as the shop supplies charge is not shown today.”
  • Key Decisions, Permissions (Action | Needs | Without it): “Edit the shop supplies amount | 'See Financial Data' and 'Invoicing & Payments — Create & Edit', as the shop supplies charge today | Field hidden (S10-N3)”
